rounds: I judge a product by its packaging more than I would like to admit.
Beautiful packaging is worth paying a bit more for.
I always read the back of the pack before I buy food.
I would order less online if it meant much less cardboard.
Packaging with jokes written on it is annoying, not charming.
Sweets and crisps should be sold in plain packaging, like cigarettes in some countries.
A pack's job is to sell the product, not to look nice in your kitchen.
Design students should spend more time in supermarkets than in museums.
